sources.name: Soo Loo
sources.quote: I think the key to my success on Tuesday night was staying focused and adapting to the situations as they came up. I took the First Hunt contract, sold some iron ore, and managed to come out 24 credits up despite getting into a few fights. It's all about making the right decisions under pressure, something I'm used to from my day job as a Corporate Accountant.

limits.rule: The Packet is what you know, not the fence around what you may write. The approved facts and the ledger are canon: never contradict them, and never import real-world Oakland (its people, businesses, landmarks, troubles). Everything else — the scene, the street, the weather in the room, unnamed people and what they say, new in-world places and businesses, what the city is talking about — is yours to invent; that colour is the job, and it never rewrites a canon fact.
